title: Disable Bing Search in Windows 10 Start Menu
description: Quick within Windows 10 on how to disable Bing within the start menu. By default, when searching within Windows 10 start menu it uses Bing search engine to search online first, so lets disable it.   Don't forget guys, if you like this video please "Like", "Favorite", and "Share" it with your friends to show your support - it really helps us out! asr.full_text: Hey guys, welcome back this is Bernal from the BTNHD and today I'm gonna show you guys how to disable Bing in Windows 10 start menu search. I don't like that. So let's get started. So first thing first, I'm going to right click on the start menu, I'm going to click on Run, I'm going to type in win ver press ok. And I did the following tip and trick within a Windows 10 1903 build. So hopefully it works out with other builds. Okay, so what do I mean about the Bing search within the Start menu so if you start typing in a keyword or phrase for me was MDT and BTNHD. The Start menu is going to automatically try to search online. I don't want that I want it to search locally, my files first so disabling is pretty easy. We're going to right click on our Start menu, click on Run and when I type in reg edit, click OK. You're going to get the user account control dialog box, click Yes. And we're going to go to the following we're going to go into HKEY current user software within software locate Microsoft within Microsoft locate Windows within Windows locate current version and within current version, and within current version look for search. Now within search we are going to right click on the primary node, the folder search, we're going to go to new and we're going to create a D word 32 bit value, and we're going to give it the following name, capital B bin capital S search and capital E enabled. altogether, one word, bin, search enabled, we're gonna double click on it and make sure that the value is 0 Y24 is going to give you zero, just make sure it says zero, click OK. Now when you go back inside your Start menu, and I don't really think you need to restart your machine because it's like a quick, kind of hack, go inside your start menu and type a phrase or keyword for me I did the MDT and BTNHD And it said no results found. It didn't go online so it's a good thing. Awesome. So hopefully you guys enjoy this tip and trick within windows 10, leave comments right below Don't forget about hitting that like button and I catch you guys on the next one. Peace out.
